description: In every expansion satisfying the definitions, the specified elimination graph satisfies \(G_t(v,b)\leftrightarrow b=t[v]\), for every shared term, assignment, and output.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.realize_termGraph.{u, v, u', v', w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type z} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) [(L.sum K).Structure M]
  [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M] (h : d.GoodExpansion M) (t : (L.sum K).Term α) (v : α → M) (y : M) :
  (d.termGraph t).Realize (Sum.elim v fun x => y) ↔ y = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize v t
